title: Object names
description:
Check names for kernel objects (events, mutexes, mappings) and their namespaces.

```
"Local\XenonReady"   -> ok (this session)
"Global\XenonReady"  -> ok (all sessions; may need a privilege)
"XenonReady"         -> ok (same as Local)
"Bad\Name\Here"      -> refused: only one backslash after the namespace
""                   -> unnamed object
```
hints: Kernel object names share one namespace per session, so a mutex and an event may not have the same name.
requirements: Recognise `Local\` and `Global\` prefixes; anything else is local.
After the prefix, the name may not contain another `\` and must be under 260 characters.
Suggest a name made from your app and a purpose, like `Local\Xenon-Build-Ready`.
stretch: Add a per-user suffix so two users in the same session cannot clash.
